sous_titre: Ventes mensuelles des magasins d'articles de sport, variation sur un an, en %, de février 2025 à février 2026

Février 2025.texte: sales for sporting goods stores during the month of February reached $3.61 billion, representing a decrease of 10.2 percent

Avril 2025.texte: sales for sporting goods stores during the month of April reached $4.36 billion, representing a decrease of 2.2 percent

Juin 2025.texte: sales for sporting goods stores during the month of June reached $4.96 billion, representing a decrease of 5.7 percent

Juillet 2025.texte: sales for sporting goods stores during the month of July reached $5.08 billion, representing no change (+0.1%)

Février 2026.texte: sales for sporting goods stores during the month of February reached $3.85 billion, representing an increase of 6.6 percent
